# Action catalog

!!! info "Generated from the code"
    Generated by `scripts/gen_docs.py` — do not edit by hand. Run the script after changing the code.

Actions CareFlow's agents may propose, from `backend/app/policy.py` (`CATALOG`, `FORBIDDEN`). Administrators and hospital directors can decide any approval.

## Catalog

| Action | Departments | Risk | Approver | Required parameters | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notify_department` | documentation, pharmacy, laboratory, insurance, billing | low | runs automatically | `message` | Send a reminder to the department queue |
| `create_followup_task` | documentation, pharmacy, laboratory, insurance, billing | low | runs automatically | `title` | Create a follow-up task for the department |
| `create_document_task` | documentation | low | runs automatically | `doc_id`, `missing` | Ask the responsible person to complete a document |
| `request_lab_acknowledgement` | laboratory | low | runs automatically | `report_ids` | Ask the lab desk to acknowledge final reports |
| `escalate_pharmacy_task` | pharmacy | medium | Discharge coordinator | `task_id` | Escalate a pharmacy task to the duty pharmacist |
| `retry_portal_submission` | insurance | medium | Insurance desk lead | — | Retry submission to the payer portal |
| `attach_document_to_claim` | insurance | high | Insurance desk lead | `claim_id`, `document` | Attach an existing document to an insurance claim |

## Never executable

These are refused by the policy check whatever an agent or a document says:

- `authorize_discharge`
- `mark_medically_fit`
- `prescribe_medication`
- `modify_medication`
- `approve_claim`
- `record_payment`
- `modify_invoice`
